t: A powerful camera board that runs vision models and small language models.
steps: Find the MaixCAM2 board and its wiki on the Sipeed site.
Ask IT to help with buying and shipping.
Choose the 1 GB or 4 GB memory version.
Install MaixVision on a Windows, Mac, or Linux computer.
Power the board and connect it with a USB-C cable.
Run a sample MaixPy script for object detection.
Review any online sign-in before students use it.
